object.attr: derived: CF-S5, E13. A team that groups documents in a folder, or keeps a copy in an archive folder, would otherwise get a clean mellon-check that checked none of them. Files git doesn't track, the req-test fixture among them, are left out. Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S5). Replaces the draft's statement that nested folders aren't documents (review Q62).
object.description: If git tracks a file <folder name>.xml with root element document in a folder two or more levels below the repository root, outside dot folders, Mellon shall report a load error for the folder.
